_comment: Generated by tools/render-doc.js from a lesson's les-01_lesson-proposal record (gate-redesign-2026-10-06.md A6.2: one consolidated per-lesson gate = interior design + activities + per-slot coupling). User-facing 'lesson plan'. The lesson's title/topic/description/outcomes come from crs-04_lesson-map; interior design, check, activities and coupling from les-01. Field paths are ALIGNED to les-01's decidedValueShape (design-kb/design-kb.gates.json): teaching.pattern = interiorPattern; check.items = the 3-item formative check (tests/coupling); generalMcqSet / contextQuestionSlot / activityProposals / coupledSlots are the les-01 fields verbatim. See lesson-plan.example.json for the shape.
intro: A plain-language plan for one lesson. Generated from the lesson's design record; where this and the record differ, the record wins.
